svg.title: BESS at the Data Center Integration Team
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-data-center-bess-integration-team; chapter number: 11; chart type: org_architecture; title: BESS at the Data Center Integration Team; subtitle: Grid-forming storage as the price of interconnection, not an add-on; caption: AI training loads jump 30-60% in milliseconds and mass-trip on voltage dips; Lyten reports flattening up to 99.5% of load-step volatility in controlled tests (Volta Foundation).; assumptions note: Spoke roles map practitioner specialties to integration functions; no speaker prescribed this org chart or a headcount. KPI figures are attributed claims from the named firms.; note: Attributed to Keentel Engineering (BTkszCEW7nY), Digital Infrastructure Network for ABB (U2apRbTTZuE), UL Solutions (TtbHyJ6xzNg), ALL4 Environmental Consultants (-B0ACVnCSu0) and Rand Simulation (LBt7MoTnFFQ).; center: role: Data center BESS integration lead; headcount: Not reported by practitioners; focus: Grid-forming BESS sized to buffer AI load swings and carry islanding behind the gensets; spokes: role: Power-quality and EMT study engineer; type: Engineering consultant (Keentel Engineering); kpi: Validated vendor models, EMT and harmonic studies, and TDD at the PCC confirmed before the purchase order; role: BESS and digital switchgear supplier; type: Equipment OEM (ABB via Digital Infrastructure Network); kpi: 20 ms full-load pickup; islanding under 0.5 s including upstream breaker opening; role: Fire testing and code compliance; type: Listing body and permitting advisers (UL Solutions, ALL4); kpi: UL 9540 listing plus full-scale fire test; 100 kWh at 2 ft triggers the NFPA 855 Chapter 9 test; role: Thermal and airflow simulation; type: CFD specialist (Rand Simulation); kpi: Full-site airflow run at 30% and 60% design under moderate wind; intake held below 54C
